name: lookml-explore-doc
description: Generate Excel documentation (labels, groups, mart lineage, business logic) for LookML explores, fully offline.

commands.title: LookML Doc: Generate Documentation for All Explores in a Model

lookmlDoc.remoteProjects.markdownDescription: Map LookML project names used in `//project/...` includes to local folders. `${workspaceFolder}` is supported. Example: `{ "one-hub": "D:/CLT/lookml_one_hub", "one-crm-spoke": "${workspaceFolder}" }`

lookmlDoc.outputDir.description: Default folder for generated Excel files. Empty = parent folder of the workspace (keeps files out of the LookML repo).

lookmlDoc.codeLens.description: Show a 'Generate Doc' CodeLens above each explore.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle
